name: Strawberry Sprint XR
summary: Strawberry Sprint is the first immersive mixed-reality greenhouse agricultural simulation in the world, developed by Digi Fuzz Verse in the Food Valley (Wageningen, Netherlands). Designed for intuitive spatial play, it lets you cultivate real strawberry varieties right inside your physical space using natural hand and controller interactions.
